scoring_justification: Absolute formation energies and migration barriers are strongly method-dependent (pseudopotentials, code, Ueff); verify the robust relative stability ordering of defects as reported in the paper.

schema.value_type: object with numeric fields O_rich and O_poor (eV)

outputs.description: Formation energies of Gd defects under O-rich and O-poor conditions. The relative ordering among the three defects is scored to verify thermodynamic stability (Gd-V_O-Gd should be lowest).

schema.description: Array of objects with defect name (single_Gd, Gd_V_O, Gd_V_O_Gd) and migration barrier in eV.

outputs.description: Minimum migration barriers for the three defect types. The relative ordering is scored to verify kinetic stability (Gd-V_O-Gd should have the highest barrier).

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies that under both O-rich and O-poor conditions, Gd_V_O_Gd has the lowest formation energy and the highest migration barrier, using appropriate tolerances for numeric values.

steps.description: Verify that Gd_V_O_Gd has the lowest formation energy under O_rich and O_poor conditions.
Verify that Gd_V_O_Gd has the highest migration barrier (strictly greater than single_Gd and Gd_V_O).
